metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel scheduled analytics rule that detects high-volume blocked file upload attempts (>10 per user per hour). Supports compliance with FINRA 4511, SEC 17a-4, and OCC 2011-12 by surfacing persistent attempts to upload unauthorized file types through Power Platform environments.
metadata._needsHumanReview: Verify OCC 2011-12 reference — OCC Bulletin 2011-12 covers model risk management, not file upload restrictions. Consider OCC 2023-35 (third-party risk) or omit pending compliance team confirmation.

metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is enabled.
Azure region for the analytics rule resource. Defaults to the resource group location.

resources.name: [concat(parameters('workspaceName'), '/Microsoft.SecurityInsights/', variables('alertRuleName'))]
resources._apiVersionNote: This API version is functional but outdated. Do not bump without validating the ARM template against the target API version schema in a test workspace first, as newer versions may introduce required fields or rename properties.

properties.description: Detects users with more than 10 blocked file upload attempts within one hour, which may indicate persistent attempts to upload malicious or unauthorized file types. Part of Control 1.25 — MIME Type Restrictions for File Uploads.
properties.query:
// This query uses PowerPlatformDlpActivity_CL (custom log table).
// If your environment uses the standard connector, substitute PowerPlatformAdminActivity.
PowerPlatformDlpActivity_CL
| where OperationType_s in ("Blocked", "Denied", "BlockedUpload") or ActionTaken_s == "Block"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| summarize BlockCount = count() by UserPrincipalName = UserPrincipalName_s, EnvironmentName = EnvironmentName_s
| where BlockCount > 10
| project UserPrincipalName, EnvironmentName, BlockCount

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: User {{UserPrincipalName}} had {{BlockCount}} blocked file upload attempts in environment {{EnvironmentName}} within one hour.
